title: Insert Language-Tag Directories Under Every Bundle
description: Insert a language/framework subdirectory (js, rs, py, go, cs) directly under every bundle's own implementation location repo-wide, so each bundle's source can later be rewritten in a different language without moving the bundle itself. Dismantle cad/js umbrella. Skip bundles already compliant (final segment is language tag). Split genuinely mixed-language bundles. Update all config surfaces.
summary: Inserted language-tag subdirectories (js, rs, py, go, cs) under every bundle implementation repo-wide so sources can later move to another language without relocating the bundle. Dismantled cad/js umbrella into cad/* bundles each with local js/. Split mixed bundles (flow/core, coda/client/bin/assistant, compose/client/bin/engine, repo/server/coordinator). Left already-compliant bundles untouched (draw/rs, kernel/2d/js, etc.). Updated root Cargo.toml workspace members, go.work, repo/go.work, Monorepo.sln, package.json workspaces/exports, script.ts cwd/rsDir paths, and repaired Cargo path deps + include_str paths. Verified cargo check --workspace, note-core and draw-core vitest, repo cli go build. Ticket scripts: migrate-language-tags.ts, fix-exports.ts, repair-cargo-paths.ts, find-remaining-root-sources.ts, verify-log.md, changed-files.txt (344 paths).
